sites.name: Bells Bend Outdoor Center
sites.accessDetail: The park closes at dusk. Use a scheduled public star party for night access.
sites.darknessDetail: A nearby hosted observing option. Nashville skyglow and local lights can limit faint targets.

sites.name: Mammoth Cave · Visitor Centre grounds
sites.accessDetail: Use the open grass or parking area near the visitor centre. Indoor services close in the evening.
sites.darkness: Bortle 4 across most of the park
sites.darknessDetail: International Dark Sky Park. The NPS park-wide rating can differ at the visitor centre, especially near lights and headlights.

sites.name: Scott’s Gulf · Virgin Falls Trailhead
sites.accessDetail: The park limits after-dark viewing to registered programme participants and backcountry campers. Distance is to the trailhead.
sites.darknessDetail: Tennessee State Parks highlights the trailhead area for low local lighting. No verified site rating.

sites.name: Obed · Lilly Bluff Overlook
sites.accessDetail: The overlook is a 0.6-mile round trip from parking, with its clearest views mainly to the south.
sites.darknessDetail: International Dark Sky Park. This is a moonless SQM reading at Lilly Overlook from December 2016.

sites.name: Pickett–Pogue · Astronomy Field
sites.accessDetail: The dedicated observing field is above the gravel Pogue Creek Canyon trailhead car park on TN-154.
sites.darknessDetail: Tennessee State Parks rates Pickett–Pogue Class 3. The astronomy field’s 2016–2018 readings ranged from 20.61 to 21.43 mag/arcsec².
